cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — standing; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing; a Roman marble bath hall — perched on a ledge or edge; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — kneeling on the ground; a city rooftop with a water tank — sitting on the ground; a glass skybridge between station towers — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — drinks from a water bottle; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — ties the cord around a bound bundle of bamboo slips; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — perched on a ledge or edge; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — holds her keepsake at chest height; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — carries a camera by its grip at her side
